# agents.PromptActivation

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Makes a prompt version active; a rollback is a new activation of an older version.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `agents.PromptActivation` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |
| Permission | `core.prompt.read` |

| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization of a tenant addendum; null for platform scope. |  |
| `versionId` | yes | `none` | Version made active. |  |
